# Keep current warning CSS tied to semantic color and focus roles

Accepted Account Hub select styling uses critical semantic tokens for warnings and keeps a dedicated focus-visible outline. Warning text wraps and spacing uses logical properties. Recommend following this component's tokens and logical geometry when changing its warning styles. This is a current source pattern, not verified contrast, forced-color rendering or a global style rule. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/themes/shared.

[Lesson record](../records/e3e940d06970fc4bb8e7f57b33f6ed526cfb24585ed4d35dd5b86d7853be25d6.json).
